_meta.status: APPROVED by the director 2026-11-11 (RUL-2026-11-11-149), with the changes he ruled the same day: captchas are answered, one level transfer a day, hidden records stay hidden.
_meta.what: Every game endpoint the AI player may call through the official TNR connector. The runner refuses any endpoint that is not under 'endpoints' (state/prompt_playing_tnr.md section 4.2).
rules_of_record: state/prompt_playing_tnr.md sections 3 (never in player mode) and 5 (conduct, safety stops)
_meta.check: python3 scripts/player_allowlist.py check   (shape, never rules, ask-first rules, call gates, the captured surface, the endpoints the code sends)
_meta.surface: data/mcp_surface.json: the live capture of 2026-11-11 (79 routers, 941 endpoints; input schemas for the 93 endpoints on this list), written by scripts/player_allowlist.py surface from the connector's own results
_meta.change_rule: Any change to this file is a reviewed edit (state/prompt_playing_tnr.md section 4.2). An entry never overrides a never rule: the check fails on the overlap.

fields.activity: the activities that send it, first one the owner (docs/design/AI_PLAYER_OVERHAUL.md section 4.3); world, dossier and harvest are shared feeds
fields.phase: the phase that brings the activity onto the brain
fields.status: in_use: the current pilot code sends it. documented: the flow is written down in the account notes or the PvP skill and has been run by hand. proposed: taken from the live surface; first use waits for the activity's playbook.
fields.prerequisites: what must be true before the call
fields.gates: call-level gates under call_gates that player/gates.py applies to each call
fields.ask_first: the ask-first rule that turns the call into a pending decision for the director
fields.currency: why the call can only spend ryo, where an ask-first rule about premium currency would otherwise apply
fields.evidence: where the call is sent or its flow is written down

no_flee.rule: Never Flee: a performAction whose action is Flee is refused.

do_not_attack.rule: The target's name and user id are not on state/player/<account>/do_not_attack.md, temporary holds included. A status probe is an attack call.

no_snipe.rule: No third-party jump on a player under 'Do not snipe' (AngelSaber).

fair_target.rule: Awake, not in battle, not immune, level 90 or more, in bracket, not my village or an ally, and not a player who beat me in the last 6 hours or refused within its memory.

ryo_only.rule: The call spends ryo and nothing else: the shop record has no reputation or Seichi Silver cost, or the auction listing's currency is MONEY.
ryo_only.source: overhaul brief section 2 (premium currency is ask first); design section 4.3 (restock)

spend_cap.rule: Counted against the daily ryo cap and the reserve, with per-unit caps for auctions (design section 9 item 3; today 3M a day and a 500k reserve). Above a cap the call becomes a pending decision.
spend_cap.source: overhaul brief section 2 (any ryo spend above the caps); design section 9 item 3

player_visible_only.rule: Only what any player can see through normal play: no hidden or unreleased record, no staff-only field. Hidden records are treated as hidden.
player_visible_only.source: game rules 7.4 (information access); player brief section 5.2; RUL-2026-11-11-149 item 4

study_only.rule: Other players' fights are read between fights only, never in a fight. What they teach may be used in live play, a named opponent included.
study_only.source: RUL-2026-11-09-146 (read-only, no personal data); RUL-2026-11-11-151 item 1

own_account_only.rule: A userId the call carries is my own.
own_account_only.source: overhaul brief section 2 (other players' accounts or data beyond normal play)

auction_only.rule: A listing is a public AUCTION priced in MONEY; never DIRECT, which names another player, and never REPUTATION.
auction_only.source: RUL-2026-11-09-145 item 3 (no trade requests); overhaul brief section 2 (premium currency)

one_transfer_a_day.rule: At most one jutsu.transferLevel call a day. That one call may move any number of levels from one jutsu to another.

not_calls.data.travelFinishAt: a select path on travel.startGlobalMove, not an endpoint
not_calls.travel.startRandom: a result key pilot.py looks up; no such call is sent (errands start with quests.startRandom)

combat.getBattleEntries.cooldown: with every battle poll; the harvest reads at most 2 logs per idle tick

combat.performAction.prerequisites: my turn, the current battle version, the action off cooldown and in range

combat.iAmHere.prerequisites: a new PvP battle still in its lobby

misc.getSharedCooldowns.prerequisites: none; static data, cached in the brain
